verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a Google SERP API and a Fast Search API that return result sets, and a separate HTML API that scrapes a single URL (optionally as markdown). Nothing in the evidence shows a single call that searches and returns the full page content of the results. Chaining the two APIs is a user-side workaround, and the GPT web-enhanced search returns model answers, not result page content.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
